In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], several days before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] '''captured''' the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Sidral II]]''.

==Background==
After learning that the Empire was building the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] capable of destroying a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the Alliance attempted to discover which contractors were involved in its construction.<ref name="Xwing" />

==The battle==
As part of this operation the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Pirate/Legends|privateer]] [[Tuz]] helped to capture the ''Sidral II''<ref name="XW:OSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> while it transported a cargo of military hardware,<ref name="Xwing" /> including timers and [[fusion shell]]s.<ref name="XW:OSG" /> The Alliance dispatched the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Frazier]]'' to rendezvous with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and transfer its cargo. The operation was interrupted by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'', but the Rebel forces were able to complete the transfer before escaping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Xwing" />

==Aftermath==
Part of the stolen shipment had passed through an Imperial repair dock near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] decided to launch an [[Attack on the Imperial repair dock|attack]] on the facility in the hopes of crippling the infrastructure that was servicing ships working on the Death Star.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Behind the scenes==
Though the ''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' states that [[Operation Skyhook]] began ''after'' the capture of the ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]'', later sources such as ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' clarified that this is impossible, as Operation Skyhook's second phase results in the acquisition of the Death Star plans that are then sent to the ''Tantive IV''.
